segments.name: Transportation Solutions
products: terminals and connector systems and components
segments.description: Provides connectivity and sensor technologies for automotive, commercial transportation, and sensor end markets.
segments.evidence: The primary products sold by the Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, heat shrink tubing, relays, and application tooling.

segments.name: Industrial Solutions
products: terminals and connector systems and components
segments.description: Supplies products that connect and distribute power, data, and signals for digital data networks, automation, aerospace, energy, and medical markets.
segments.evidence: The Industrial Solutions segment is a leading supplier of products that connect and distribute power, data, and signals.

revenueModel.text: The company sells connectivity and sensor products directly to manufacturers and indirectly through third-party distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products into approximately 130 countries primarily through direct selling efforts to manufacturers.

changes.text: Effective for fiscal 2025, the company reorganized into two reportable segments, Transportation Solutions and Industrial Solutions, with prior periods recast.
changes.evidence: Effective for fiscal 2025, we reorganized our management and segments to align the organization around our current strategy.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the company acquired Richard Manufacturing Co.
changes.evidence: We acquired Richard Manufacturing Co. ("Richards Manufacturing") in fiscal 2025.
